tone.summary: A bright, punchy signal chain utilizing a Blues OD for grit, followed by an AC30 TB amp model into a 4x12 cab, enhanced with Chorus and Digital Delay for the required glam sheen.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide mid-gain crunch and bite for rhythm playing.
Keep the tone focused on OD crunch rather than heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD provides sufficient grit; no dedicated DST unit is needed to avoid excessive saturation.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British combo sound (AC30 style) for bright, mid-focused tone.
Provide a classic British cabinet voicing suitable for glam rock.
Add the required 'chorus sheen' and width to lead lines.
Implement the core delay effect for depth and glam sheen.
Add subtle ambience without sounding big or muddy.
blocks.gap: The verdict advises avoiding 'big reverb,' so Room is chosen over Plate/Spring for a controlled, natural space feel.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the bright, mid-focused AC30 sound.
